name: oh-my-joy
description: AI says it's done. OMJ makes it prove it. One workflow for Claude Code and Codex: interview, plan with an independent critique, approve once, then build, review, and verify with recorded evidence and resume. Figma-to-code built in.

interface.shortDescription: No proof, no done: critiqued plans and evidence-backed execution.
interface.longDescription: Interview a fuzzy idea, plan with an independent critique, approve once, then execute with per-goal review, verification evidence (command and exit code), and resume. Includes Figma-to-code with real browser checks and existing PR review delivery.
defaultPrompt: Turn this concrete coding task into an implementation plan with $oh-my-joy:ralplan.
Clarify this fuzzy product idea with $oh-my-joy:deep-interview.
Review my current diff without changing it with $oh-my-joy:review.
